name: Alanine aminotransferase
rangeNote: Lab limits vary a lot. The American College of Gastroenterology suggests a truly healthy upper limit of about 29–33 U/L for men and 19–25 U/L for women.
summary: ALT is an enzyme found mainly in liver cells. When liver cells are irritated or damaged, more ALT leaks into the blood.

high.meaning: A high ALT points to stress on the liver. The most common cause is fat building up in the liver.

low.meaning: A low ALT is not a concern.

biologicalVariation.population: US teens and adults aged 16–69 (NHANES 1999–2002), two samples about 19 days apart; the lab's own imprecision removed

source.title: Biological variation of laboratory analytes based on the 1999-2002 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.

sources.title: ACG Clinical Guideline: Evaluation of Abnormal Liver Chemistries
